title: Prescribed Performance Leader-Following Consensus with Event-Based Broadcasting
summary: This paper develops a prescribed performance leader-following consensus protocol for directed networks under event-based broadcasting. Each node schedules its transmissions using only its current state and its last broadcast value, while followers use held neighbor and leader samples between broadcasts. To accommodate jumps in sampled neighborhood errors caused by asynchronous receptions, a decaying receiver-side performance correction term temporarily modifies the prescribed performance function.
